# Constrained Sensitivity Lab

Artifact-backed research on how model-facing structured-output contracts change
semantic correctness, structural validity, and executable outcomes.

## Canonical routes

- Overview: https://vaibhav701161.github.io/constrained-senstivity-lab/
- Final results: https://vaibhav701161.github.io/constrained-senstivity-lab/results/

- Current status: https://vaibhav701161.github.io/constrained-senstivity-lab/evidence-status/
- Architecture: https://vaibhav701161.github.io/constrained-senstivity-lab/architecture/

- Publications: https://vaibhav701161.github.io/constrained-senstivity-lab/publications/

## Final claim boundary

The tested signed-string to internal-integer rewrite produced a positive but
uncertain Qwen estimate and a negative canonical Llama estimate. A bounded
executable tool-call pilot detected no benefit. The project therefore supports
contract-sensitivity measurement and conservative fail-closed analysis, not a
general automatic schema optimizer.

## Evidence policy

Raw JSONL, manifests, validators, paired summaries, complete audits, and frozen
decision reports are authoritative. Documentation pages are a living interpretation
layer. Effects from different models and tasks are not pooled.
